name: FX Pad
description: The board as a performance multi-effect: line 1/2, line 3/4, the mics and the computer through sixteen effects the pads hold, an XY surface for their parameters; the one app of the fxpad firmware kit
changelog: 0.1.0: FX Pad: sixteen effects (echo, tape echo, ping pong, roll, hall, shimmer, freeze, gate, LP / HP filter, band sweep, wah, flanger, phaser, bitcrush, drive) on the pads, two at once with LATCH, X/Y on the touch surface, WET from the pad's pressure; TAIL or SNAP on release, synced to the tempo; ROUTE picks the sources (line 1/2, line 3/4, mics, USB), their sends, PRE/POST, MONO, THRU and the outputs (phones, line out, USB); over core 2.47's IFxBus
